logp.method_description: Besides, the partition coefficient values were performed via shaking flask methods and calculated by HPLC methods. The standard curves were obtained from the tested compounds 7, 8, 11–14 at the concentration of 00, 200, 2000, 10000, 20000 μg/mL. As for the assays of partition coefficient, compounds 7, 8, 11–14 (30 mg) were suspended a mixture of deionized water (5 mL) and n-octanol (5 mL) in equilibrium glass bottles. The solutions were shaken for 24 h at 25 oC in dark. Subsequently, the solutions centrifuged at 5000 r/min for 20 min to offer upper or lower portion. The obtained solutions were filtered via microporous membrane and HPLC was performed to determine the contents each portion.HPLC chromatographic conditions were the same as those in section 4.9. Partition coefficient values were followed the formula: P=Co/Cw. Co represented the concentrations in-octanol, while Cw represented concentrations in water.
